description:
Take a tour of this 365± acre ranch for sale in Bell County, Texas, a versatile property offering productive farmland, scenic water features, and exceptional hunting opportunities. Whether you're searching for a working ranch, Texas hunting land, investment property, or recreational acreage, this Central Texas ranch is packed with potential.

This beautiful ranch features multiple ponds, both a live creek and wet weather creek, and approximately 50 feet of elevation change, creating a diverse landscape that supports abundant wildlife. With approximately 230± acres of productive tillable land, the property is well suited for farming, cattle operations, wildlife management, or a combination of agricultural and recreational uses.

Property Highlights

• 365± Acres in Bell County, Texas
• Multiple Ponds Throughout the Property
• Live Creek and Wet Weather Creek
• Approximately 50± Feet of Elevation Change
• Approximately 230± Acres of Tillable Land
• Abundant Whitetail Deer and Native Wildlife
• Excellent Hunting and Recreational Opportunities
• Ideal for Farming, Ranching, or Investment

If you're looking for Bell County land for sale, Texas ranch land, hunting property, farm and ranch acreage, or a recreational ranch in Central Texas, this property offers an outstanding combination of productivity, natural beauty, and outdoor recreation.
